map.Input: 男性、30 岁、170 cm、65 kg、活动系数 1.5（中等）:
Input: male, 30 years, 170 cm, 65 kg, activity factor 1.5 (moderate), goal maintenance, balanced diet (protein 25% / carb 50% / fat 25%). 
 BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor) = 10x65 + 6.25x170 − 5x30 + 5 = 1568 kcal. 
 TDEE = 1568 x 1.5 = 2352 kcal (maintenance goal means 2352 kcal/day). 
 Macros: protein = 2352x0.25/4 ≈ 147 g (2.3 g/kg); carb = 2352x0.50/4 ≈ 294 g; fat = 2352x0.25/9 ≈ 65 g. 
 Meals: breakfast 25% (588) / lunch 35% (823) / snack 10% (235) / dinner 30% (706) kcal. 
 Conclusion: this male's maintenance is about 2352 kcal/day, balanced as protein 2.3 g/kg, carb 50%, fat 25%.

map.减脂建议每日缺口 300–500 kcal（约每周 0.3–0.5 kg），过快: For fat loss, a daily deficit of 300-500 kcal (about 0.3-0.5 kg/week) is suggested; too fast easily loses muscle and triggers metabolic adaptation and rebound. For muscle gain, a surplus of 200-400 kcal is appropriate; too much turns to fat.

map.否。生酮（碳水≈5%）对部分癫痫、短期减重者有效，但长期安全性因人而异，孕妇、肝: No. Keto (carb ≈ 5%) works for some epilepsy and short-term weight loss, but long-term safety varies; pregnant women, those with liver/kidney disease or an eating-disorder history should not adopt it on their own and must do so under professional guidance while monitoring blood lipids and electrolytes.
